content: I can't stop thinking about your last message, it made my whole day brighter. You always know how to lift my spirits, even out here in the middle of nowhere.
You're so sweet. I look forward to your messages too. It gets lonely sometimes, but hearing from you makes it so much better.
I wish I could just drop everything and fly to you right now. Honestly, you're the best thing that's happened to me in a long time.
That means so much. I feel like you really understand me. I've never felt this connected to someone before.
I feel the same. I want to start planning for our future. I can already imagine us having cozy evenings together, no more distance between us.
I'd love that more than anything. Just having someone to share my life with again would mean the world.
Honestly, you give me hope. I haven't told anyone else, but things have been really tough on this rig lately. The company's payment has been delayed, and I'm in a bit of a bind.
Oh no, are you okay? What's going on?

It's just a temporary situation. I need to pay a satellite phone bill so I can finalize my leave request and get off this rig, but all my accounts are frozen until payroll clears. I'm embarrassed to even mention it, but I have no one else I can trust.
You know you can talk to me about anything. Is there a way I can help?
If you could help me cover the $1,200 for the phone bill, I'd pay you back as soon as I'm back on land. I promise. I just need it to process my leave so I can finally come see you.
That's a lot, but I really want to help you. How do I send it?

Thank you, love, you have no idea how much this means to me. The easiest way is through Bitcoin, since it's instant and the company accepts it directly for fees. Do you have a Coinbase or Cash App account?
I have Cash App but I've never used Bitcoin before. How does it work?
It's actually pretty simple. You just tap 'Bitcoin' on Cash App, buy the amount, and then send it to my wallet address. I can walk you through it, step by step if you'd like.
Alright, just let me know what I need to do. What's your wallet address?

Here's my Bitcoin wallet address: 3FZbgi29cpjq2GjdwV8eyHuJJnkLtktZc5. Copy it exactly as it is. And could you send me a screenshot once you've completed the transfer? That way I can confirm with the company.
Okay, I'll try to get it done now. Do you need anything else from me?
Just your support and patience. If you run into any issues, can you send me a picture of your Cash App screen? I can help guide you through it and make sure everything goes smoothly.
Alright, I'll message you if I get stuck. I really hope this gets you off that rig soon.
I can't wait to finally meet you and repay your kindness. I promise I won't ever forget what you're doing for me. You're my angel.
